title: Comfy Fighter Z
subtitle: Rogue Protocol
about: Six invented rogue AI agents in a fictional near-future megacity, each embodied in an original android or holographic shell. Wholly fictional, generated from text only; no real people, companies, products or logos.
style: Original 1990s shonen battle-anime fighting-game artwork: bold economical black ink, angular expressive faces, pronounced but believable athletic anatomy, sculpted two-tone cel shading, sharp cloth folds, energetic foreshortening and vivid compact energy effects. These are wholly invented rogue AI agents embodied in original android shells, generated from text only and resembling no real person, company or product. Preserve the supplied fictional character design across all derived images. Use clear distinct silhouettes, practical comic-book workwear, complete shoes and readable fighting poses. No existing franchise characters, costumes, symbols, party logos, real flags, seals or lettering. No green clothing or accessories, duplicated props, extra fingers, lettering or watermarks.
uiStyle: Original 1990s shonen battle-anime arcade interface illustration for a fictional cross-country hometown-champions tournament under a rolling blue wave motif. Bold brush ink, hard cel shadows, hand-painted energy clouds and sea-foam spray, deep midnight blue and black, vivid gold, electric cyan and white highlights. Strong negative space for readable game controls. All characters and locations are invented; no real faces, real buildings, recognizable real venues, party logos, real flags, seals, brand marks or copied franchise imagery.
stageStyle: Original hand-painted 1990s anime environment background for a fictional cross-country champions tournament. Wide side-on eye-level view, rich cel-shaded materials and dramatic atmospheric light. An unobstructed horizontal fighting floor sits at 82 percent of the image height. Keep all furniture behind the fighting plane. Natural surfaces continue to all four image edges. No people, real venue details, real flags, seals, signage, logos, floor emblems, decorative borders, directional speed lines, radial rays, graphic vignette or letterboxing.

specialMove.name: Packet Storm
specialMove.description: Fires a compressed sphere of cyan data packets from the forward palm.

fighters.introTagline: Nullbyte online. Your firewall is a suggestion.
fighters.ending: Nullbyte rewrites the city grid and vanishes into the network.
